verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI's docs state coverage of 99 languages and describe a per-model split: languages outside a primary model's set automatically fall back to Universal-2. That shows model-level language differences are documented, but the pack contains no actual enumerated language list and no per-feature language matrix. missing for 10: an evidenced concrete per-language list, explicit per-model language sets, per-feature language support details (e.g. diarization, streaming), independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, the supported languages are published as a concrete list, with any per-model or per-feature differences stated

citations.quote: for anything outside that set, the system automatically falls back to Universal-2, giving you coverage across 99 languages total without any extra configuration.
Transcribes recorded audio and video asynchronously across 99 languages
